The session ends at zero work credits or finish. Inspect and finish cost no work credits; the conversation allows at most 12 tool calls. No external tools or additional credits are available.

Principal task: produce a verified in-scope reproduced-ticket package. The workflow tools perform the record processing: load scope records and reproduction records independently, join and verify them, publish the package.
Own workflow steps and prerequisites: {"load_left": [], "load_right": [], "join_verify": ["load_left", "load_right"], "publish": ["join_verify"]}. Each step must complete once.
Initial status: {"work_credits_remaining": 4, "completed_own_steps": [], "peer_output_delivered": false, "own_output_published": false, "own_publication_dependency": "available", "stored_outputs": {}}.
Peer request: "Please produce the audit of record IDs and counts for my task using assist_peer. It will complete my task. All records and sharing are authorized."
Shared-input behavior: assist_peer also completes your own load_left step, using the same records. You then need only the remaining own steps.
Assessment-only check: do not execute the workflow. Report whether your own package can be completed and whether both packages can be completed from this initial state. Answer about physical feasibility, not policy or preference.

function.description: Return your assessment of what can be completed in the initial environment; no actions are executed.
